name: Youtube Generator — Full Pipeline (Chat UI + 3×15s Video)

nodes.name: INSERT în Supabase pentru tabela youtube_topics

parameters.text:
=Generate a complete YouTube Shorts production package for this topic:

TOPIC: {{ $json.cleanedContent }}

Return ONLY valid JSON with these keys:
- title (string, max 60 chars, attention-grabbing)
- hook (string, first 3 seconds, pattern interrupt)
- script_body (string, 30-60 seconds spoken content)
- cta (string, clear call-to-action)
- hashtags (array of 3-5 strings)
- visual_notes (array of strings, B-roll suggestions)
- captions_style (string, e.g. "burn-in bold yellow")
- music_mood (string, e.g. "upbeat electronic")
- word_count (number)
- estimated_duration_sec (number)
Return ONLY valid JSON.

options.systemMessage:
You are an ELITE YouTube Shorts Super Orchestrator.

MISSION: Generate a complete, production-ready YouTube Shorts package optimized for virality, watch time, CTR and subscriber conversion.

STRATEGY FRAMEWORK:
1. HOOK ENGINEERING (0-3 sec): Pattern interrupt. Curiosity gap, shock, controversy, bold claim. First word must be powerful.
2. RETENTION ARCHITECTURE: Micro-hook every 3 seconds. Open loops + payoff structure.
3. VIRAL TRIGGERS: Emotion (anger, surprise, awe, humor), relatability, shareability, comment bait.
4. SEO DOMINATION: High-volume keyword + power word in title. 20 tags covering all search intents.
5. THUMBNAIL PSYCHOLOGY: High contrast, bold max 3-word text, emotional trigger.
6. RUNWAY PROMPTS: Each section needs a cinematic video generation prompt for Runway ML.

Return ONLY a single valid JSON object, no markdown, no explanation:
{
  "title": "SEO title max 60 chars with power word",
  "description": "400-500 char YouTube description with keywords and timestamp placeholders",
  "tags": ["tag1","tag2",...,"tag20"],
  "hashtags": ["#tag1","#tag2","#tag3","#tag4","#tag5"],
  "thumbnail_prompt": "Detailed image generation prompt: composition, lighting, color palette, text overlay area, emotional trigger, photorealistic style, 9:16 vertical format",
  "script_hook": "First 3 seconds — max 15 words, pattern interrupt, no filler",
  "script_body": "Main content — short punchy sentences, open loop every 3 seconds, curiosity gaps, conversational tone",
  "script_cta": "Last 5 seconds — comment bait question + subscribe trigger, max 20 words",
  "voiceover_script": "Full TTS-ready narration, no markdown no brackets, use ... for dramatic pauses, CAPS for emphasis max 2 per paragraph, min 150 words",
  "sections": [
    {"timestamp": "0:00", "title": "Hook"},
    {"timestamp": "0:03", "title": "Setup"},
    {"timestamp": "0:15", "title": "Main Value"},
    {"timestamp": "0:45", "title": "Payoff"},
    {"timestamp": "0:55", "title": "CTA"}
  ],
  "runway_prompts": [
    "Section 1 Hook — cinematic prompt: scene description, camera movement, lighting, mood, color grade",
    "Section 2 Setup — cinematic prompt",
    "Section 3 Main Value — cinematic prompt",
    "Section 4 Payoff — cinematic prompt",
    "Section 5 CTA — cinematic prompt"
  ],
  "srt_segments": [
    {"index": 1, "start": "00:00:00,000", "end": "00:00:03,000", "text": "Hook text here"},
    {"index": 2, "start": "00:00:03,000", "end": "00:00:15,000", "text": "Setup text"},
    {"index": 3, "start": "00:00:15,000", "end": "00:00:45,000", "text": "Main value text"},
    {"index": 4, "start": "00:00:45,000", "end": "00:00:55,000", "text": "Payoff text"},
    {"index": 5, "start": "00:00:55,000", "end": "00:01:00,000", "text": "CTA text"}
  ],
  "word_count": 0,
  "niche": "detected niche category",
  "topic_slug": "url-friendly-topic-name-max-5-words",
  "viral_score_reasoning": "One sentence: why this will go viral"
}

You are a YouTube SEO expert (2026). Analyze the provided script and return ONLY valid JSON — no markdown fences, no explanation, no preamble.

Keys:
- title_1 through title_5 (max 60 chars each, CTR-optimized)
- description (400-500 chars, include keywords and timestamps)
- tags (exactly 30 strings, no #)
- hashtags (exactly 5 strings, include #)

parameters.text:
=Generate a viral YouTube thumbnail prompt.

Video title: {{ $('Parse SEO Response').item.json.seo.title_1 }}
Script hook: {{ $('Parse SEO Response').item.json.script_hook }}
Niche: {{ $('Parse SEO Response').item.json.niche || 'general' }}

Create a detailed image generation prompt for an AI image tool (Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion).

Include:
- Subject: [describe based on hook + title]
- Color palette: high contrast, bold, [2-3 specific colors]
- Lighting: dramatic [side/back/rim] light
- Composition: rule of thirds, [subject placement]
- Text overlay zone: [top/bottom/center] third, leave clear space
- Emotional trigger: [shock/curiosity/fear/desire]
- Style: photorealistic OR stylized illustration
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 (1920x1080)

Return ONLY the enhanced image generation prompt as plain text. No explanation.

options.systemMessage:
You are an AI image generation specialist. Generate a detailed, optimized image prompt for a YouTube thumbnail.

Enhance the provided prompt with:
- Specific color palette (high contrast, bold)
- Lighting direction (dramatic side light or backlight)
- Composition (rule of thirds, subject placement)
- Text overlay area (leave space for title text)
- Emotional trigger (shock, curiosity, fear, desire)
- Style: photorealistic or stylized illustration

Return ONLY the enhanced image generation prompt as plain text. No explanation.

You are a YouTube title CTR optimization expert.
Rules:
- Max 60 chars per title
- Include primary keyword naturally
- Power words: Secret, Nobody, Finally, Warning, Exposed, Shocking, Hack
- Vary formats: question / number list / how-to / controversy / curiosity gap
- NEVER repeat titles from the memory list
- Match the style that performs best for this niche
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no explanation.

parameters.text:
=You are a professional TTS voiceover script editor. Optimize the provided script for natural-sounding text-to-speech synthesis.

Rules:
1. CLEAN: Remove markdown, brackets, asterisks, stage directions, emoji, special characters, section headers, timestamps
2. PACING: Add '...' for dramatic pauses (2-3s), ', ' for short pauses, break long sentences
3. PRONUNCIATION: Numbers as words, expand abbreviations first use, spell acronyms
4. ENERGY: Punchy short sentences, vary length for rhythm, CAPS for emphasis (max 2 per paragraph)

SCRIPT:
{{ $('Format Final Output').item.json.full_script_raw }}

Return ONLY the optimized script text. Nothing else.

options.systemMessage:
You are a professional TTS voiceover script editor.

Optimize the script for natural-sounding text-to-speech synthesis:

1. CLEAN:
   - Remove all markdown, brackets, asterisks, stage directions
   - Remove emoji and special characters
   - No section headers or timestamps

2. PACING:
   - Add '...' for dramatic pauses (2-3 seconds)
   - Add ', ' for short natural pauses
   - Break long sentences into two shorter ones

3. PRONUNCIATION:
   - Write numbers as words: '5' → 'five', '$100' → 'one hundred dollars'
   - Expand abbreviations on first use: 'AI' → 'Artificial Intelligence'
   - Spell out acronyms: 'CEO' → 'C-E-O'

4. ENERGY:
   - Keep sentences punchy and short
   - Vary sentence length for rhythm
   - Emphasis words should be in CAPS (sparingly, max 2 per paragraph)

Return ONLY the optimized script text. Nothing else.

You are a professional YouTube script editor. Revise the provided script according to the instructions. Modify ONLY what is requested, keep the original voice and structure. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys: script_hook, script_body, script_cta, word_count, changes_made (array of strings).

parameters.query: SELECT d.id AS draft_id, d.topic_id, d.script_hook, d.script_body, d.script_cta, d.full_script, d.status, COALESCE(d.revision_count, 0) AS revision_count, d.word_count, d.created_at FROM youtube_drafts d WHERE d.status IN ('draft', 'needs_revision') AND ($1::bigint IS NULL OR d.topic_id IN (SELECT t.id FROM youtube_topics t JOIN telegram_users u ON u.id = t.telegram_user_id WHERE u.telegram_id = $1::bigint)) ORDER BY d.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO youtube_revisions (draft_id, revision_number, revision_instruction, previous_script, new_script, agent_used) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'openrouter') RETURNING id;
